users_partner_role_ck.name: users_partner_role_ck
users_partner_role_ck.value:
("users"."role" IN ('partner_admin','dispatcher') AND "users"."partner_id" IS NOT NULL)
        OR ("users"."role" = 'super_admin' AND "users"."partner_id" IS NULL)
        OR "users"."role" IN ('rider','driver')

users_role_audience_ck.name: users_role_audience_ck
users_role_audience_ck.value:
("users"."role" = 'rider' AND "users"."audience" = 'rider')
        OR ("users"."role" = 'driver' AND "users"."audience" = 'driver')
        OR ("users"."role" IN ('partner_admin','dispatcher','super_admin') AND "users"."audience" = 'admin')
